title: Red Bull Bragantino opens 2-0 lead over Ferroviária in Women's Copa do Brasil Quarterfinals
subtitle: Away victory ensures Red Bull Bragantino the lead in the first leg of the quarterfinals
excerpt: Red Bull Bragantino defeated Ferroviária 2-0 at Arena da Fonte Luminosa, gaining an advantage in the first leg of the Women's Copa do Brasil quarterfinals.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Red Bull Bragantino secured a crucial away victory in the Women's Copa do Brasil. On Monday evening (12), 'Massa Bruta' defeated Ferroviária 2-0 at Arena da Fonte Luminosa, in Araraquara (SP), in the first leg of their quarterfinal clash.

With the 2-0 scoreline, Red Bull Bragantino establishes an advantage for the return leg, which will determine the team advancing to the competition's semifinals. The result places the team in a favorable position, requiring only a balanced performance in the second leg to secure qualification.

The Women's Copa do Brasil continues with teams facing each other in home-and-away ties from the quarterfinals onwards, where the aggregate score determines progression to the next stage. Each matchup has the potential to change the course of the competition, and performance in the first leg often influences teams' strategies in the decisive return matches.

With information from Agência Brasil.
